revision_source: The superproject gitlinks pin the checkouts; candidate_ref records why each pin was selected.

libraries.name: expat
evidence: The original DLLs export Expat parser and tokenizer APIs.
The expatpp header describes compatibility with Expat 1.95.6; that makes this a starting candidate, not evidence of AIM's exact revision.
AIM_xmlp.dll has VC7.1 Rich records; xmlparse.dll and xmltok.dll have older toolchain records. Treat their revision and build profiles independently.

libraries.name: expatpp
evidence: This is Andy Dent's standalone upstream repository, with expatpp and expatppNesting source.
The source header identifies a 29-Dec-2002 version compatible with Expat 1.95.6.
The Git history contains a 2018 SourceForge import rather than the original development history. Earlier revision searches need release archives or older mirrors.
AIM exports setTokensString and tokenToIndexNumber, which are absent from this checkout. skipWhiteSpace is present.
libraries.dependency_policy: Use the separately pinned vendor/expat for experiments; the upstream repository's bundled expat is historical reference data.

libraries.name: nspr
evidence: All three original version resources identify NSPR 4.4.1.
The checkout's pr/include/prinit.h defines PR_VERSION as 4.4.1.
AOL_NSPR_4_4_1_BASE and NSPR_4_4_1_RTM resolve to the same commit in this mirror.

libraries.name: nss
evidence: The first four original DLLs identify NSS 3.9.2 in version resources and embedded build strings.
The checkout's security/nss/lib/nss/nss.h defines NSS_VERSION as 3.9.2.
nssckbi.dll belongs to the NSS family, but its built-in certificate data revision remains unpinned.
